title: Family Travel Tip No. 71 of 365: Explore the Hotel Lobby Before Heading to Your Room… 🏨✨
description:
Family Travel Tip No. 71 of 365: Explore the Hotel Lobby Before Heading to Your Room… 🏨✨

Most families do the exact same thing after check in.

Grab the key.
Rush to the room.
Drop the bags.

We used to do that too.

Until one trip changed the way we travel with kids forever.

Now every time we arrive at a hotel during a family vacation, Daddy Barry and I do one small thing first.

We pause in the lobby and explore for a few minutes with the kids.

And it always pays off.

Here’s why this simple family travel tip works so well:

1️⃣ You discover hidden things
Many hotels have little gems in the lobby. Free snacks, welcome drinks, kids corners, or activity boards.

2️⃣ Kids decompress after travel
After flights or long drives, the lobby gives kids a moment to stretch, explore, and reset.

3️⃣ You spot important things faster
Breakfast area, elevators, restrooms, luggage carts, pool entrance. Knowing the layout saves stress later.

4️⃣ You start the stay feeling relaxed
Instead of rushing straight to the room, the whole family transitions slowly into “vacation mode.”

Some of our best travel surprises actually started in hotel lobbies.

A kids welcome pack.
A free hot chocolate station.
Even a surprise cultural performance once.

Little things… but they make traveling with kids feel magical.

Family travel isn’t just about the destination.

Sometimes the best moments start before you even reach the room.

Save this tip for your next trip ✈️

And tell me in the comments…

Do your kids run straight to the hotel bed… or straight to the pool? 😆
